summary: Navios Maritime Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine operational and financial updates, including vessel sales, sale-leaseback transactions, credit facilities, and a common unit repurchase program. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or other special situation is announced. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, with no board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms. What to watch: none; this is a standard financial disclosure with no special-situation implications.
